findings.evidence: The exposed definitions include `grading`, `descendedGradedVal`, and `gradedCoaction`; `mem_grading_iff`, `coe_descendedGradedVal`, and `coe_gradedCoaction` already characterize their observable behavior.
findings.fix: Remove blanket `@[expose]` here and at Subalgebra.lean:36; use the characteristic lemmas downstream and expose individual bodies only where computation requires it.
findings.issue: Both new algebra files use blanket `@[expose] public section`, exposing implementation bodies despite providing membership and coercion APIs.

findings.evidence: Lines 88–90 reduce descended-piece membership to ambient membership; lines 176–177 reduce membership of a comparison-map image to source-piece membership. The parallel `Subalgebra.mem_grading_iff` already carries `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: `mem_descendedGrading_iff` and `baseChangeEquiv_mem_iff` lack `@[simp]`, leaving characteristic membership reductions unavailable to simplification.

summary: The API unnecessarily exposes definition bodies and omits automation annotations on characteristic membership lemmas.
